boundaries: MRCS productizes and expands the existing Multiversal Content Forge rather than creating a parallel authoring database or rules engine
owner-domain contracts remain authoritative for the meaning of governed rules and content definitions
CAB remains completed advancement/balance authority and cannot be silently reopened, simplified or superseded by MRCS
CNI retains modular conditional-content runtime authority; MRCS authors compatible definitions and packs rather than a second runtime
ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, rights/use capability and imported/generated asset provenance
Action/Event and other runtime owners retain canonical mutation authority; definitions, previews and simulations never prove live events occurred
MCS, MCCS, MAS and MSAS retain specialized creator-domain ownership while MRCS may bind to their outputs

GPR consumes accepted MRCS Actions, Effects, Conditions, Resources, Abilities, items, creatures, vehicles, environments, encounters and scoped rule definitions for reusable gameplay-pattern execution; MRCS remains definition/authoring authority

MERA consumes accepted MRCS component, interface, compatibility, engineering-profile, work-recipe and blueprint definitions for playable engineering/refit gameplay rather than moving engineering execution authority into MRCS
MBES consumes accepted MRCS construction/material/facility/blueprint definitions and later MERA engineering capabilities for playable built-environment and settlement gameplay
definition, variant, template, form, placement, live instance and projection/stat-block layers remain distinct
mechanical prose should reference governed Actions, Effects, Conditions, Resources, Abilities and other shared records where available
core, setting, campaign, adventure and playtest rule scopes require explicit precedence, compatibility, enable/disable and rollback semantics
content cannot be labeled balanced solely from schema validity; owner-approved CAB or domain harness evidence is required where applicable
legacy import and repair preserve source text, source prices, aliases/history and unresolved source gaps rather than inventing missing semantics
ordinary authoring is no-code; bounded formulas/predicates/selectors may be exposed for advanced use without unrestricted scripting by default
optional AI remains advisory and cannot silently publish, canonize or mutate live state
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking authoring, validation, packaging or review workflows
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected source, assets, schemas, distinctive UI expression and private protocols are not copied
no implementation authority until separately governed start
